label: Ollama (local)
notes: Your own machine, so there is no quota to meter and no key to hold — the point of auth.type: none. Set OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:11434 to enable. Priority 90 keeps it as the last resort, i.e. the thing that still answers when every hosted free tier is exhausted. Leave models empty; discovery lists whatever you have pulled.
